derivation: or (feminine) גֹּרָה; a variation of H1482 (גּוּר)
def: {a cub (as still abiding in the lair), especially of the lion}

occurrences.text: The lion did tear in pieces enough for his whelps, and strangled for his lionesses, and filled his holes with prey, and his dens with ravin.
